// why: The conformance gate, in its own config for one reason: it reads dist/, and
dist/ is gitignored. Putting it in tsconfig.json would make `npm run
typecheck` fail on a fresh clone that has not built yet, which turns the
repository's first command into a confusing error.
`npm run verify` builds before it checks, so this runs there with everything
in place. What it proves is in the head of typings/conformance.d.ts.
